messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#INC-98123 — AZ7 NIC error-rate spike (>5%), svc=inference-runtime, severity=page

pagerduty: Incident PD#INC-98123 created and paging group 'sre-primary' (auto-retry 3x)

alice: acked — taking initial lead. seeing packet drops from az7-nic0 on metrics dashboard https://dash.company/az7/nic (spike started ~T-3m) :eyes:

sre-oncall: oncall join — verifying. can you paste the alert details / rolling logs?

alice: alert payload: {"metric":"nic.errors","threshold":5.0,"value":12.3,"svc":"inference-runtime"} 

alice: tail from runtime log (cut):
```
2026-03-15T15:04:12Z inference-runtime[pid=4221]: EVAC_WARN: connection rt=522ms errors=6 nic=az7-nic0
2026-03-15T15:04:21Z kernel: eth0: tx timeout
2026-03-15T15:05:03Z inference-runtime[pid=4221]: shard=3 model=llama-2 cache_miss=0.1 failure=0.02
```

jack: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=az7-node` to see pod distribution

ops-bot: Autoscaler: AZ7 pod count temporarily reduced by 3 due to node readiness=false (retries=2).

kate: customers on az7 ~ 14% of total requests. initial impact: 5% error spikes, 10-20% elevated latencies for pinned model variants.

alice: can we route traffic away from az7? recommend prefailover plan: - enable routing-fallback to region-west-2, - scale up warm capacity there by +30%. need approvers.

sre-oncall: agreed. initiating routing divert. invoking runbook step: `eng-runtime divert-traffic --from az7 --to region-west-2 --percent 100 --grace=30s`

ops-bot: runbook command queued: divert-traffic (initiator=sre-oncall). awaiting confirmation from control-plane.

pagerduty: PD#INC-98123 status: acknowledged by alice, assigned to sre-oncall. next escalation in 7m.

ops-bot: control-plane confirm: BGP routes updated, route policy 'fallback-az7' applied, BLOB: https://internal/ops/route/789	

jack: kicked a manual warm-up on region-west-2: `replicaset scale inference-west-2 --replicas +40`

kate: customer impact update: external prod traffic diverted ~T+2m, 85% successful reroute, some long tails for live sessions — product-ops wants to send a heads-up to top 10 customers.

product-ops: drafting message. short note: "We saw elevated errors in a subset of traffic routed to AZ7. We've diverted traffic to region-west-2 while we investigate; no data loss expected. We'll update in 30m."

alice: monitoring kv-cache eviction rate — saw small spike; will keep an eye for cache thrash after routing change.

sre-oncall: checking health probes across az7 nodes — some nodes reporting intermittent NIC resets. suspect intermittent hardware flapping on az7-rack-4. opening a cloud ticket for host replacement.

ops-bot: cloud-ticket created: CT-44291 (host replacement requested; ETA 25m).

jack: confirm failover: curl -s https://traffic.company/status | jq '.regions["region-west-2"].healthy_percent' => 97

kate: running customer impact calc: before divert error rate in az7 => 12.3%; after divert residual errors system-wide => 0.7%. good mitigation.

alice: PD note: marking 'mitigated' in PD if metrics remain stable for next 10m. still keeping page open until host replacement and health stable.

sre-oncall: ops: please coordinate host replacement with cloud. once replaced, we'll drain node and run soak for 15m before returning traffic.

ops-bot: cloud update: host az7-node-142 rebooted and under hardware test. previous NIC shows hardware ECC errors.

pagerduty: PD#INC-98123: escalation paused (ack). next automation check in 10m.

alice: quick note — observed a second smaller spike at T+9m on a different switch (az7-switch-2). not sure if related. adding network team. @network-team please review switch logs.

kate: product-ops: please queue status page update after 15m if stable. include note on affected percentage and actions taken.

network-team (via DM): switch logs show microbursts at 15:13Z aligning with the first NIC errors; possible port flapping on switch-2. reconfiguring port-level errdisable thresholds now.

alice: running post-divert verification: 1) token latency p95 region-west-2=210ms, 2) request success rate=99.3%, 3) no model shard rebalances triggered. all looks ok so far.

sre-oncall: decision: keep diversion active and do controlled re-attach after cloud confirms NIC replacement and switch stable. note: do NOT bring az7 back to 100% traffic until soak >=15m.

ops-bot: cloud: host replacement complete (CT-44291). NIC firmware updated to v2.3.4.

jack: draining az7-node-142: `kubectl drain az7-node-142 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — pods evacuated.

alice: soak monitoring started at T+25m. p90/p95 stable. no regression alerts.

product-ops: status page update posted: https://status.company/incidents/INC-98123 — brief, link to this thread.

pagerduty: PD#INC-98123: agent note: mitigation in place, awaiting soak window. will auto-close on stable metrics or manual resolution.

kate: next steps: 1) keep prefailover route active for 15m soak, 2) validate with network team that switch-2 thresholds changed, 3) follow-up customer comms in 30m.

alice: at T+35m soak looks healthy. starting gradual traffic reattach: `eng-runtime divert-traffic --from region-west-2 --to az7 --percent 25 --step=25 --wait=60s`

ops-bot: traffic reattach step completed: az7 receiving ~25% traffic, no errors observed.

sre-oncall: raise PD to 'resolved' only after az7 at 100% for 15m and no reoccurrence.

alice: reattach to 50% now. monitoring.

network-team: port flapping thresholds adjusted, no further errdisable events. switch-2 logs clean for last 18m.

jack: reattach to 100% complete at T+67m. final verification: global error-rate back at baseline 0.3%.

alice: marking PD incident as resolved in our notes; leaving PD open for 10 more minutes then close if stable.

product-ops: customer comms updated: follow-up explains root cause (NIC + switch microbursts) and mitigation (host replacement + routing fallback). preparing postmortem.

sre-oncall: thanks everyone. postmortem owners: alice + network-team + ops. fill in runbook gaps: consider automation to quickly re-route on NIC ECC errors (auto-prefailover). :memo:

incident-bot: PD#INC-98123 — timeline appended to ticket. reactions: :white_check_mark: :spiral_calendar: 

alice: final status: incident resolved. closing thread. thanks all.
